english-language.q1.cliffharvest.1.all: any two of: 'a loaf of dark bread' (dropped into the sea) [line 1-2]; 'sheer'; 'three hundred metres'; 'black rock streaked white'

english-language.q1.chess.3.all: any two of: sat by the window; chessboard; playing against himself; face as still as a closed door

english-language.q1.afterwater.3.all: any two of: upper floor crowded with everyone; washing hung from the windows; goat on a corrugated roof bleating; line of women rinsing pots

english-language.q1.postcard.1.all: any two of: best bread I have ever eaten; river that turns copper-coloured at sunset; brass band that has played every Sunday; for 112 years
